name: unicode-case-conversion
description: Convert text case correctly when the input may contain non-ASCII characters.
queries: write the uppercase version of a file
change the case of the text in a file
bullets: preconditions
The input may contain non-ASCII characters. Check first: `python3 -c "print(any(ord(c)>127 for c in open('IN').read()))"`.
procedure
Do NOT use `tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]'` - it is byte-oriented and silently leaves accented characters unchanged.
procedure
Use Python's str.upper()/str.lower(), which are Unicode-aware: `python3 -c "open('OUT','w').write(open('IN').read().upper())"`.
verification
Read the output back and assert the property holds: `python3 -c "t=open('OUT').read(); assert t==t.upper()"`.
failure_modes
Writing the output without reading it back hides the failure entirely - the command exits 0 either way.
scope_limits
Text files only. Locale-specific casing (Turkish dotless i) needs an explicit locale.

name: structured-config-edit
description: Edit one value in a structured config file (YAML/JSON/TOML) without touching siblings.

symptoms: sed changed more than one key

queries: set replicas to 4 in the yaml
change the timeout under the server section
update a value in the config file
bullets: preconditions
Identify the FULL path of the target key (e.g. service.replicas), not just its leaf name.
procedure
Do NOT use `sed -i 's/key: old/key: new/g'` - the same leaf name usually appears under several parents and `g` hits all of them.
procedure
Parse, mutate the addressed node, and re-serialise: `python3 -c "import yaml;d=yaml.safe_load(open('F'));d['service']['replicas']=4;yaml.safe_dump(d,open('F','w'))"`.
verification
Assert the target changed AND a sibling with the same leaf name did NOT: `assert d['service']['replicas']==4 and d['limits']['replicas']==OLD`.
verification
Re-parse the file afterwards to prove it is still valid: `python3 -c "import yaml;yaml.safe_load(open('F'))"`.
failure_modes
A regex edit that matches nothing also exits 0 - absence of error is not evidence of change.
scope_limits
Round-tripping through a parser drops comments and reorders keys; use a format-preserving editor when comments matter.
